papers.title: Exam candidate's note
lines: Mathematical Tripos, third paper. Question four: I have written 'see me afterwards' and a drawing of a cow.
Candidates are reminded that cows are not on the syllabus.

papers.title: Punt hire slip
lines: One punt, one hour, one pole. Gentlemen are reminded not to fall in. Ladies are reminded that the gentlemen will.
Deposit returned if the pole is. The pole is not always.

papers.title: Eel-catcher's note
lines: Set the grigs on the dyke. Back before the mist lifts, which on these fens is when God allows it.
If the wherry goes by, wave. If it doesn't, wave anyway. There is nobody else to talk to.

trail.clue: An eel-catcher's cache of coin lies near the windpump, in a biscuit tin.

papers.title: Drainage board minute
lines: Resolved: that the windmill be repaired, the dyke be dug, and the board be fed.
The last item was carried unanimously and with some enthusiasm.

papers.title: Draft plaque wording
lines: 'A man of science lived here, 1887 to 1934.' This is the entire plaque. Nobody could think of anything else.
Suggested addition: 'He kept bees.' Rejected as unreliable.
